T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

strings: I'm Doris from SIZA Gloves Co., of china, and we have good advantages to supply various industrial work gloves.

*At present, we have 2 glove factories, and we have very big advantages in functional gloves, reusable nitrile chemical gloves and neoprene chemical gloves.
*Such as cut resistant gloves/sleeves, heat resistant gloves/sleeves, cryogenic gloves, impact gloves, nitrile work gloves(33cm,45cm,50cm,60cm long), latex & nitrile dry box gloves(70-80cm), and neoprene gloves etc.
If you have any interests about it, kindly contact us. We could give our competitive offer for your reference.

----
Thanks and Regards,
Doris Zhang,  Siza Safety Supplies Co., Ltd.
No. 8 Qingjiang Road, Hongfu Industrial Park, 
Xinbei District,Changzhou,China 213022
